items.q: In a galvanic cell, oxidation takes place at the:
items.qAf: In ’n galvaniese sel vind oksidasie plaas by die:
items.explain: Oxidation (loss of electrons) occurs at the anode in a galvanic cell.
items.explainAf: Oksidasie (verlies van elektrone) vind by die anode in ’n galvaniese sel plaas.

items.q: E° for Cu²⁺/Cu is +0,34 V and E° for Zn²⁺/Zn is −0,76 V. What is the standard emf of a Zn–Cu galvanic cell?
items.qAf: E° vir Cu²⁺/Cu is +0,34 V en E° vir Zn²⁺/Zn is −0,76 V. Wat is die standaard-EMK van ’n Zn–Cu-galvaniese sel?

items.q: Which is the strongest oxidising agent among Ag⁺ (E° = +0,80 V), Cu²⁺ (+0,34 V) and Zn²⁺ (−0,76 V)?
items.qAf: Watter is die sterkste oksideermiddel onder Ag⁺ (E° = +0,80 V), Cu²⁺ (+0,34 V) en Zn²⁺ (−0,76 V)?
items.explain: The most positive E° value belongs to the strongest oxidising agent: Ag⁺.
items.explainAf: Die mees positiewe E°-waarde hoort by die sterkste oksideermiddel: Ag⁺.

items.q: In an electrolytic cell, reduction takes place at the:
items.qAf: In ’n elektrolitiese sel vind reduksie plaas by die:
items.explain: Reduction (gain of electrons) occurs at the cathode, which is the negative electrode in electrolysis.
items.explainAf: Reduksie (opname van elektrone) vind by die katode plaas, die negatiewe elektrode in elektrolise.

items.q: An iron spoon is electroplated with silver. Which electrolyte should be used?
items.qAf: ’n Ystervurk word met silwer elektrogeplateer. Watter elektroliet moet gebruik word?
items.explain: The electrolyte must contain Ag⁺ ions so that silver is reduced onto the spoon (the cathode).
items.explainAf: Die elektroliet moet Ag⁺-ione bevat sodat silwer op die lepel (die katode) gereduseer word.

items.q: A charge of 2 F (2 mol of electrons) passes through a CuSO₄ solution. What mass of copper is deposited? (M(Cu) = 63,5 g·mol⁻¹)
items.qAf: ’n Lading van 2 F (2 mol elektrone) gaan deur ’n CuSO₄-oplossing. Watter massa koper word neergeslaan? (M(Cu) = 63,5 g·mol⁻¹)
items.explain: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu, so 2 mol e⁻ deposit 1 mol Cu = 63,5 g.
items.explainAf: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu, dus slaan 2 mol e⁻ 1 mol Cu = 63,5 g neer.
